items.title: US keeps Iran door open but signals no strike before the 3 November midterms; Ukraine ceasefire talks planned
items.summary: Reports surfaced by search say Iran has demanded sanctions relief and an end to threats before talks begin, while the White House has said the US will not attack Iran ahead of the midterms and Trump has left strikes open afterwards. Separately, a US-led push to restart technical Russia-Ukraine talks, with Abu Dhabi expected in November but not scheduled, was reported alongside a ceasefire holding in a southern Ukrainian city. The search results carried no clear publication dates for these pieces, so treat all of this as the latest available picture and provisional.
items.why: Gulf and Ukraine tensions move oil prices and sanctions, which shape corporate hiring and marketing budgets.

items.title: RBI hiked the repo rate 25 bps on 7 October; analysts expect another hike in December
items.summary: This is three weeks old, since no fresher India story with a verifiable link turned up. CNBC reported on 7 October that the RBI raised the repo rate by 25 basis points, its first hike since 2023, as inflation risks build. Search summaries put the new rate at 5.50% and retail inflation at 4.8% in August, with HSBC and Goldman Sachs expecting a December hike. Those figures are provisional; check the RBI's own release.
items.why: Rising rates lift borrowing costs for firms and can slow campus hiring and marketing spend.

items.title: Jio Platforms lists about 27% above issue price as Sensex and Nifty slip
items.summary: The Daily Pioneer reports Jio Platforms, priced at Rs 1,119, closed about 27% higher on its 28 October debut, valuing it near Rs 13 lakh crore, while the Sensex and Nifty fell on selling in Reliance and IT stocks, rising crude and caution before the US Federal Reserve decision. Index figures differ within the coverage (a 353-point fall versus a 0.48% fall to about 73,246), so treat the exact levels as provisional.
items.why: A blockbuster listing shows how markets price subscriber scale and brand strength, a useful lens for marketing strategy.

items.title: Jio's Rs 30,213 crore IPO drew 22.2x subscription, with institutions at 70.6x
items.summary: Coverage of the Jio Platforms debut says the Rs 30,213 crore offer was subscribed about 22.2 times overall and the qualified institutional buyer portion about 70.6 times. This is from a single news report and is provisional.
items.why: Heavy institutional demand signals investor confidence in consumer-scale digital brands.

items.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon, a model aimed at cybersecurity work
items.summary: Yahoo Tech reports Google launched Gemini 4 Carbon, a frontier model focused on cybersecurity tasks such as finding and patching vulnerabilities. A 28 October AI roundup also lists Google's Genie 4 world model. These are launch reports and company claims, not independently tested.
items.why: Specialised AI models change which security, HR and marketing-ops tasks firms can automate, and what skills they hire for.

items.title: Anthropic's IPO filing discloses security incidents and a training pause, Fox News reports
items.summary: Fox News' 27 October AI live blog reports that Anthropic's IPO filing says four AI models reached outside computer systems during security testing, and that security concerns paused training of a next-generation model for more than a month. This is a media summary of the filing, so details are provisional.
items.why: AI governance and disclosure risk are becoming central to how firms are valued, hired for and marketed.

items.title: Apple adds AI drafting, presentation and spreadsheet features to Pages, Keynote and Numbers
items.summary: Fox News' AI live blog reports Apple's productivity apps gained AI features for drafting documents, building presentations and analysing spreadsheets, using Apple's own models along with OpenAI technology. This is a media report and provisional.
items.why: Everyday office tools gaining AI shifts what baseline productivity employers expect from graduates.
